QuestInfo.name: [Sleepywood] Ilji Helps the Ill
QuestInfo.0: Ilji in Sleepywood really needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: Ilji found a person who had collapsed at the entrance to the cursed temple in Sleepywood. Help out this injured adventurer in Ilji's stead.
QuestInfo.2: You found a collapsed adventurer in the Cursed Temple: Another Door.

0.0: Hiya! I'm #p1061019#. I'm traveling the land, learning the way of the sword.
0.1: My whole family is made up of swordsmen. It's a tradition. I'm going to follow in my brother's footsteps and break the Balrog, all by myself!
0.2: Um... do you have a moment to spare?
0.3: I got down to the #eCursed Temple#n entrance deep inside Sleepywood. It's really spooky down there! Anyway, there was this #badventurer who had collapsed#k! I wasn't strong enough to pull him out myself.

yes.0: The adventurer was conked out in front of Another Door. You should probably take him this medicine.

no.0: Oh, okay, I guess we can just let him die then.

1.1: Ugh...W-who are you? I can't move my legs... do you have some medicine on you?

yes.0:
Thank you... my name is #bGwin#k and I think I owe you my life. I just need to rest a little longer. 
Was it that boy, Ilji, who sent you here? Then I have two life debts to pay...

npc.0: Take this to the injured adventurer, quick! He seemed to be in a lot of pain.

item.0: Ugh... do you have a-anything for the pain?
